excludedApiCategories.reason: A generic passthrough that POSTs arbitrary ops undermines the typed, allowlisted surface and the preflight safety checks; deliberately not exposed.
Returns sensitive banking data; out of scope for the initial credential-scoped surface.
Bulk CSV ingestion is batch-oriented and not exposed through the MCP tool surface.
Matching/pairing operations can move funds automatically and are excluded until explicit review.
Cancelling existing documents is a destructive, high-impact write; excluded from the write surface.
Charging stored cards causes real payment movement and requires financial-compliance review.
Recurring payment configuration changes billing behavior over time and is excluded.
Writing or reading stored card data is sensitive and out of scope.
Permanent customer deletion is destructive and excluded.
Only the linked-receipt write is exposed; arbitrary document creation is gated behind the same write flag but not implemented.
Managing the hosted billing service itself is an admin concern, not an accounting data read/write path.
Private SDK/package management is outside the accounting-data tool surface.
Desktop/mobile app integration endpoints are unrelated to the MCP accounting surface.
